backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining all data types (UserProfile, Role, PermissionRequest, Update, Media, Reminder, Message, StudyMaterial, DocumentMetadata, etc.) and including MixinAuthorization and MixinStorage for access control and blob storage functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting four features related to debugging and fixing the ProfileSetupModal role selection flow, including state management, backend mutation, and enhanced debug logging.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-existing summaries of frontend files including App.tsx with ProfileSetupModal debug logging, useQueries hooks, Dashboard with role-based rendering, and various page components for the FamilyHub application.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS styles defining OKLCH color palette with warm family-friendly tones for light and dark modes, including custom CSS variables for background, foreground, primary, secondary, and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with page title "FamilyHub" and root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with TanStack Router setup, ProfileSetupModal component with comprehensive debug logging for role selection flow (checking both null and undefined role values), and route definitions for all pages.
frontend/src/components/AIConflictAnalys: AI conflict analysis component for parents with toggle switch to enable/disable analysis, analyze button to detect family communication conflicts, and display of mock conflict descriptions with remedies.
Displays AI-generated study tips and performance insights with recommendations, showing analysis levels (basic/intermediate/advanced) and loading states using React Query hooks.
frontend/src/components/DoubtClearingInt: Provides a Q&A interface for students to ask questions and receive AI-generated answers, with conversation history and ability to mark problems as resolved.
frontend/src/components/FightsCreatedWid: Displays and allows editing of the count of family conflicts detected through AI analysis, with inline edit functionality and counter updates.
frontend/src/components/FightsSolvedWidg: Shows the count of resolved family conflicts with inline editing capability, mirroring the FightsCreatedWidget structure but for solved conflicts.
frontend/src/components/HappinessMeter.t: Visualizes family happiness score as a percentage with color-coded progress bar and emoji icons, based on family communications and interactions.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main application layout component with navigation header, Internet Identity authentication, and route-based navigation for Home, Photos, Reminders, Locations, Chat, and Education sections.
frontend/src/components/PermissionApprov: React component for parents to view and approve/deny pending permission requests from children, displaying activity type, reason, and timestamp with approve/deny buttons.
frontend/src/components/PermissionReques: React form component for children to submit permission requests to parents, allowing selection of activity type (go out, play games, watch YouTube), entering a reason, and specifying parent's principal ID.
frontend/src/components/ProblemsSolvedWi: Dashboard widget that displays the total count of resolved educational problems/doubts with a trophy icon and badge.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance with authentication, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state and identity persistence using AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for all backend API calls including user profiles, messages, locations, permissions, educational data, file uploads, and AI analysis features.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom warm color palette design tokens for light and dark modes, defining CSS variables for UI theming.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/Chat.tsx: Chat page component that allows family members to send and receive messages, with user selection dropdown and AI conflict analysis for parents. Uses Internet Identity for authentication and displays messages in a scrollable area.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page displaying family updates feed with role-based widgets including happiness meter, problems solved, permission requests/approvals, and fights tracking. Includes debug logging for role-based widget visibility.
frontend/src/pages/EducationalHub.tsx: Educational hub with tabbed interface for uploading question papers and answer scripts, viewing materials, AI analysis results, and doubt clearing. Supports file uploads with progress tracking using ExternalBlob.
frontend/src/pages/LocationSharing.tsx: Location sharing page that uses browser geolocation API to get current coordinates and allows users to share their location with family members. Displays coordinates and handles location permission errors.
frontend/src/pages/MediaGallery.tsx: Media gallery page for uploading and viewing family photos and videos with descriptions. Supports file uploads with progress tracking and displays media items with author information and timestamps.
frontend/src/pages/Reminders.tsx: React component for displaying and creating family reminders with due dates, status indicators (overdue/due soon/upcoming), and authentication-gated access using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, persisting, and managing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration for parameter persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes (including warm palette), typography, container settings, animations, and design tokens using OKLCH color space.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking implemented features, architectural notes, known issues, and requirements for a family communication app with AI analysis, sentiment tracking, and permission management.
